name: SSH
description: Lists the hosts in your ssh config and opens an ssh session in a new terminal, through bastion hosts when you name them. A session an agent asks for opens only after you approve the exact command.

commands.title: SSH: Connect to Host…
commands.argument: Host, as you would type it after ssh: [-J bastion] [-p port] [user@]host

commands.title: User, host name, port and bastion hops of one host (JSON)
